assumptions_challenged: That a consensus guidance document (MISEV2023) can, by itself, establish that the SGL-001 program is not ready to advance without program-specific CMC/analytics artifacts.

That the reviewers’ specified prescriptive actions (exactly three GMP-like batches, GLP large-animal bridging studies, fixed 3-month timeline, filing pre-IND/Scientific Advice in two jurisdictions) are mandated by or derivable from the cited MISEV guidance.
That absence of program-specific documentation in the provided evidence necessarily implies those documents do not exist (vs. not having been submitted for review).
falsification_conditions: Provision of program-specific, contemporaneous MCB and WCB qualification dossiers demonstrating identity, traceability, and stability testing consistent with regulatory expectations.
Submission of three (or program-agreed number of) GMP-like batch records with in-process controls and release test results showing reproducible critical quality attributes across lots.
Analytical validation reports for orthogonal intact-EV assays (including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, robustness) demonstrating fit-for-purpose performance and lot-to-lot comparability.
Validation of a stability-indicating potency assay with data correlating assay readout to an in vivo PD endpoint (bridging data demonstrating biological relevance).

GLP or GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity study reports that include intact-EV-specific analytics, appropriate negative/vehicle controls, and demonstrate reproducible CNS exposure across lots/species.

A regulator-briefing package and documented pre-IND/Scientific Advice responses in at least one jurisdiction that accept the proposed gating/validation approach or specify alternative, program-appropriate requirements.
strongest_objection: The reviewers conflate MISEV2023 field-level guidance with program-specific proof and then prescribe prescriptive, numeric gating criteria (e.g., exactly three GMP-like batches, GLP large-animal studies, fixed timelines). MISEV2023 does not provide program-level data nor mandate those exact requirements, so the conclusion that the program is unsupported to advance rests on absence of program artifacts rather than contradicting program data and overstates what the cited guidance requires.
